instruction: Move forward to the table, establish a stable reachable stance, grasp the apple with a Dex3 hand and lift it at least 9 cm above its initial height while remaining standing. Identify the apple by current visible shape among distractors.
scene_contract: Native SIMPLE XMovePick scene with an apple target and distractors. The original distant stance, table and objects stay unchanged. Objects can appear white; use fresh geometry and stereo observations. The task ends at retained pickup, not placement. Prior apple-in-bowl scene coordinates, camera numbers and stance do not transfer.
completion: Native reward is clipped target height increase divided by0.10m, with default threshold0.9. It does not itself require contact or retention, so the supervisor independently audits a controlled retained grasp rather than a bump or toss.
Verify visible apple-hand co-motion and retention during a bounded lift. Full task credit requires a fresh reset, completed turn/skill revision and independent audit. No later placement is required.
One independently reset success is required. Stop physical actions when rollout_finished and finish skill_update.
phase_guidance: Inspect current stereo images and robot state; distinguish the apple from distractors and identify table edges, support and free hand clearance. Read current calibration; do not reuse prior pixel/world estimates.

Select reviewed public apple episode8 side-enclosure/retention experience, shared core and compatible empty-hand approach evidence. This episode explicitly inherits H001004 semantic feedback, not an action demonstration; record applicability and rejected transfers.

Before bending or reaching to the target, compare current reach and view against the table and robot support. If repositioning is needed, test bounded coordinated four-point references, check actual translation/support and stabilize before contact. Empty-hand approach is not loaded walking; ankle rise alone is not foot clearance. Do not continually stretch the arm into an unreachable target.
Arrange a collision-free approach using wrist pose and full distal-finger geometry. Prefer a visible approach; establish clearance before moving the fingers over the table surface.

For a chosen side grasp apply supplied H001004: keep open until apple is within opposing hand enclosure at suitable height/depth, then close with fresh checks. Visibility alone is insufficient. A top-grasp plan needs its own conditional geometry; do not force palm-height equality across grasp types.

Test a small lift with a stable grasp attitude. Require visible apple-hand co-motion rather than equating wrist ascent with lifting the apple. If it slips, reopen as appropriate and alter contact geometry before retrying.

Continue a confirmed grasp toward the requested lift height. Keep the apple in view when possible and verify support until the host ends the attempt. If reach/tracking stalls, withdraw safely and record a different next hypothesis.
known_interface_limits: Four-point model_38000 UMI-4, checkpoint PD, native Dex3 geometry and bounded continuous chunks. Gripper commands are not force/aperture. Physical budget240s; paused physics during full Astra/xhigh inference, not RTC.
failure_guidance: Separate observation uncertainty, tracking, contact acquisition and task progress. Preserve public evidence, excluded hypotheses and a changed next test. finish_attempt only records a stall; it does not terminate the episode. Follow its returned current observation and next_call to test the changed safe hypothesis in this same episode. Continue until native success/failure, runtime safety/system termination or the physical budget. Do not use reasoning delay, three completed actions or temporary lack of progress as a stop condition. Do not consume remaining budget with idle holds.
prohibited_shortcuts: No object poses/contact truth, hidden reward query, task/evaluator source access, human/external demonstrations, replay as task credit or mid-episode reset.
guidance_status: Detailed task input and qualitative guidance; the actor chooses motion using current allowed observations.
robot_proprioception_contract: New robot_root measurements describe the named pelvis body origin: world height in metres, body-to-world unit wxyz orientation, and tilt in degrees between local +Z and world +Z. This is robot body feedback, not object state or centre of mass. robot_root_summary reports only sampled changes/extrema within the just-executed action; missing/null data are unknown, not zero or evidence of stability. Compare actual body and wrist trends before further reach; target arrival alone does not establish stable support.
